Manifest.Name: 暗格储物标签 / Smuggler Bay Tabs
Manifest.Author: CanisMinor
Manifest.Description: 走私者暗格和走私者暗格(改进)可以使用储藏区扩建套件增加储物标签页。暗格每次增加 2 页，改进暗格每次增加 1 页，最多 5 页，与储藏区和储藏区(扩建)相同。 The smuggler bay and the improved smuggler bay accept the storage expansion kit. The bay gains 2 tabs per kit, the improved bay gains 1, and both stop at 5 tabs, matching the storage bay and the expanded storage bay.
